settings.heading: Thoughtful gifts begin with people who care about the details
settings.text: Elma Vada is a Dallas studio creating personalized corporate gifts and engraved awards. With 5+ years of experience and a team of 10+ people, we help you plan meaningful gifts from the first idea to the finished piece.
settings.image_alt: Elma Vada team in their Dallas gift studio with personalized engraved pens, wooden gift boxes, and custom corporate gifts prepared for B2B clients and wholesale orders.

settings.heading: Our Mission
settings.text: At Elma Vada, we manufacture individually engraved gifts and awards — so that every employee, client, and partner is recognized by name, not by company logo.
settings.vision_text:
At Elma Vada, we envision a future where every company treats recognition as seriously as the work it rewards. Over the next five years, we aim to personalize gifts year-round from our own production facility, supported by annual corporate contracts, government contracts for gifts and awards, and a strong direct-to-consumer brand.

We aspire to build a reputation that attracts national brands and agency partners while creating opportunities for our team to grow and build meaningful careers.

settings.title: The People Behind Your Project
settings.text: Clear communication matters as much as the finished piece. We work through the occasion, artwork and practical details with you.

settings.title: Gifts with Meaning
settings.text: Engraving gives personal meaning to everyday objects. It can express love, appreciation, or remembrance, creating lasting impressions and joy.

settings.title: Care for Giver and Recipient
settings.text: We care about both the person choosing the gift and the person receiving it. Quality and thoughtful presentation help each feel valued.

settings.title: Thoughtful Choices
settings.text: Meaningful gifts begin with time, intention, and care. We value the thought our customers put into choosing something personal and unique.

settings.title: Confidence at Every Step
settings.text: Our goal is to make choosing a gift feel clear and reassuring, with a smooth experience from the first click to delivery.

settings.title: Precision in Every Detail
settings.text: We bring care and precision to every name, message, and detail, because the quality of the finished gift matters.

settings.title: Respect, Care & Growth
settings.text: We treat our team and customers with respect, gratitude, and care. We are committed to learning and growth for our people, founders, and brand.

settings.heading: Our Core Values
settings.introduction: The principles that guide our craft, our service, and our team.

settings.heading: Our Contribution
settings.text: Social responsibility is important to our business because we want to support the community where we live and operate. One way we currently do this is by donating custom engraved pens for community events in the Dallas–Fort Worth area. These donations help local organizers provide useful, personalized items for their events while also allowing us to contribute our products and production capabilities to the community.

settings.heading: Social Impact
settings.text: As we grow our B2B business, we see an opportunity to continue supporting local community organizations, nonprofit events, and educational programs through product donations and discounted engraving services. This creates social value for the community while also helping Elma Vada build meaningful local relationships and brand awareness.

settings.heading: Payment Policy
settings.text:
Payment in full is required before we begin production or fulfill an order. This applies to all orders, including personalized and custom engraved products.

We purchase materials and schedule production based on confirmed orders, so we’re unable to accept payment plans or release products before the full payment has been received. For larger orders, alternative payment terms may be considered only if agreed to in writing before the order is placed.

Your order is confirmed once payment has been received. Thank you for supporting our small business.

settings.question: What information should I send for a quote?
settings.answer: Share the occasion, estimated quantity, target date, delivery location and any artwork you already have. A budget range helps narrow the options.

settings.question: Can every gift have a different name?
settings.answer: Include personalization requirements in your request. We will confirm the suitable product, method and recipient-list format for the project.

settings.question: Can I review a mockup or sample first?
settings.answer: Get a free custom mockup before you order. Physical samples are available for qualifying projects; our team will confirm arrangements and any delivery cost. Request a sample. For an in-person review, request an office visit in Dallas–Fort Worth. Our representative comes to your office; the location and appointment details require confirmation.

settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: Small orders can be ready in as little as 1 business day. Turnaround time varies by product, quantity, design complexity, artwork approval, and inventory availability. Your quote will confirm the project schedule; shipping time is separate.

settings.heading: What else would you like to know?
What do you have in mind?
settings.text: Tell us who the gift is for, your estimated quantity and your target date. We will help you define the next step.

settings.heading: We Come to Your Office
settings.text:
Planning gifts for your employees, clients, partners, or an upcoming event? An Elma Vada representative can visit your office in the Dallas–Fort Worth area to discuss your project in person.

We’ll review your gifting needs, quantities, timeline, and personalization options, and bring samples for you to explore.

You’ll also receive a complimentary pen engraved with your name or company logo.
settings.fine_print: Office visits are arranged by appointment. Send us your office address and preferred availability, and we’ll confirm the location and meeting details with you.
